subject: religious-studies
title: Christmas and Easter
welcome_lead: Celebrate the two biggest Christian festivals: Christmas and Easter.
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure on Christmas and Easter, the major Christian festivals.
final_note: You can now describe Christmas and Easter and what they mean to Christians.

concepts.def: Story of Jesus's birth in Bethlehem.
Four weeks before Christmas, preparing for Jesus.
Forty days of preparation before Easter.

walkthroughs.body_html: Christmas is celebrated on 25 December. It remembers the birth of Jesus in Bethlehem. Christians attend church services, sing carols, and many enact the nativity story with shepherds, angels and wise men. The four weeks before are called Advent.

Easter is the most important Christian festival. It marks Jesus's death on Good Friday and his resurrection on Easter Sunday. It comes after 40 days of Lent — a time of fasting, prayer and giving things up.

Christmas symbols include trees, lights, stars and gifts (remembering the wise men's gifts to Jesus). Easter symbols include eggs (representing new life) and the cross. Both festivals mix Christian meaning with older traditions.
